name: Oshinobi Ouji to Mayonaka no Kiss
original_name: おしのび王子と真夜中のキス
source:
One day, you are suddenly asked to become the temporary interpreter of a foreign prince visiting Japan. Between Japan and your prince's homeland, how far will this love full of troubles lead you?!

[from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.arismile.o17a153]Google Play[/url]]
